tools.arguments: {"command":"python -c \"import json,glob,collections,os; files=sorted(glob.glob('alerts/alerts_at_*.json')); seen=collections.defaultdict(list);\\n[seen[(a['labels'].get('alertname'),a['labels'].get('namespace'),a['labels'].get('service_name'),a['labels'].get('pod'),a['labels'].get('severity'),a.get('state'))].append(os.path.basename(f).split('T')[-1][:8]) for f in files for a in json.load(open(f))];\\n[print(k,'first',v[0],'last',v[-1],'n',len(v)) for k,v in seen.items() if any(x and x not in ('KubeClientCertificateExpiration',) for x in k)]\"","timeout":120,"access":"workspace"}

tools.name: shell
tools.arguments: {"command":"python -c $'import json,glob,collections,os\\nfiles=sorted(glob.glob(\"alerts/alerts_at_*.json\"))\\nseen=collections.defaultdict(list)\\nfor f in files:\\n for a in json.load(open(f)):\\n  l=a[\"labels\"]; k=(l.get(\"alertname\"),l.get(\"namespace\"),l.get(\"service_name\"),l.get(\"pod\"),l.get(\"severity\"),a.get(\"state\")); seen[k].append(os.path.basename(f).split(\"T\")[-1][:8])\\nfor k,v in seen.items(): print(k,\"first\",v[0],\"last\",v[-1],\"n\",len(v))\\nprint(\"ALERTING SNAPSHOT\",json.dumps(json.load(open(\"alerts/alerts_in_alerting_state_2025-12-15T175546.713186Z.json\")),indent=2))'","timeout":120,"access":"workspace"}

tools.arguments: {"command":"python -c $'import pandas as pd,json\\ndf=pd.read_csv(\"k8s_events_raw.tsv\",sep=\"\\\\t\",usecols=[\"Timestamp\",\"Body\"])\\nfor _,r in df.iterrows():\\n try:\\n  x=json.loads(r.Body)[\"object\"]\\n  if x.get(\"type\")==\"Warning\" or x.get(\"reason\") in (\"FailedCreate\",\"FailedScheduling\",\"BackOff\",\"FailedMount\",\"Unhealthy\",\"Killing\",\"OOMKilled\"):\\n   print(r.Timestamp,x.get(\"type\"),x.get(\"reason\"),x.get(\"involvedObject\",{}).get(\"namespace\"),x.get(\"involvedObject\",{}).get(\"kind\"),x.get(\"involvedObject\",{}).get(\"name\"),\"count\",x.get(\"count\",x.get(\"deprecatedCount\")),x.get(\"message\"))\\n except Exception: pass'","timeout":120,"access":"workspace"}

tools.arguments: {"command":"python -c $'import pandas as pd\\nf=pd.read_csv(\"otel_objects\" if False else \"k8s_objects_raw.tsv\",sep=\"\\\\t\",usecols=[\"Timestamp\",\"Body\",\"ResourceAttributes\",\"LogAttributes\"],low_memory=False)\\n# Filter objects by relevant workload/controller/namespace using parsed serialized Kubernetes objects\\nfor _,r in f.iterrows():\\n b=r.Body\\n if any(t in b for t in [\"frontend-proxy\",\"frontend-675fd7b5c5\",\"checkout-5dccddf8bb\",\"flagd-c47676d99\",\"load-generator-c7cbc4c99\",\"ResourceQuota\",\"NetworkPolicy\"]):\\n  try:\\n   import json; o=json.loads(b); m=o.get(\"metadata\",{}); ns=m.get(\"namespace\", \"cluster\"); k=o.get(\"kind\"); name=m.get(\"name\")\\n   if k in [\"Deployment\",\"Pod\",\"ReplicaSet\",\"Service\",\"ConfigMap\",\"ResourceQuota\",\"NetworkPolicy\"]:\\n    print(r.Timestamp,ns,k,name, str({\"spec\":o.get(\"spec\"),\"status\":o.get(\"status\")})[:1600])\\n  except Exception: pass'","timeout":120,"access":"workspace"}
